trainer.dialogueBefore: Tuber Trenton: My rubber ring and me can float all day! Want to battle while I dry off?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Tuber Trenton: Sploosh. That's the sound of me losing.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Tuber Mariel: I'm not allowed past the rocks without a grown-up. But I'm allowed to battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Tuber Mariel: I'm going back in the water. It's nicer than losing.
